mutual_exclusion: Only one CI owner mode may be active for a material SHA at a time.
governed_delivery_rule: After material CI is terminal green, corrigir-ci closes CI ownership and returns a structured envelope to the existing entregar-issue controller. Only entregar-issue performs finalize-after-ci, post-write refreeze, result-only publication, and terminal handoff validation. corrigir-ci never recursively invokes entregar-issue from delegated mode.
